title: Android GridLayout nested wrap-content width
purpose: Check that a nested wrap-content GridLayout grows with its child and moves the following sibling.
changes: The nested grid now measures its columns using the current renderer text metrics and child state.
steps: Find Small, More and After under Nested wrap-content grid. They should appear next to one another.
Tap Change grid label. Small becomes Longer nested and grows; More and After should move without overlapping. Tap again to restore Small.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and repeat. The order should mirror with all three controls adjacent. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The nested grid grows and shrinks with its child and both following controls remain adjacent in either direction.
limits: This covers supported Bhoo grid measurement. Complex weighted constraints, Android font and theme behavior and device parity remain unverified.
validation: Rust regression verifies nested width, sibling positions, non-default text metrics and RTL.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified nested width, sibling placement and RTL.
